Animal · 3 hexes · SM +2 Elk [Monsters on Automatic, SRD coverage: mundane land animals; answers Elk (SRD 5.1)]

A deer the size of a horse, carrying a rack wide enough to catch on branches. Out of season it is only meat that runs away. In the rut a bull is loud, sleepless and looking for something to fight, and it will settle for a party crossing its meadow.

Notes

  • GCS ancestry draft: gcs/elk.gct
  • Independent build total: -11 points of racial traits plus 6 points of racial skills.
  • Answers the SRD heading(s): Elk (SRD 5.1). Only the creature identity is taken from the SRD; the GURPS statistics, ratings and prose are this project's own work and reproduce no SRD text.
  • Typical Stats, damage and ratings are derived from the racial template, not authored beside it, so the sheet and the stat block cannot disagree.
  • Movement: ground Move 5, 10 at a sprint (primary). The published Move folds this creature's Enhanced Move into a single figure.
  • Treasure and grappling are not authored for this batch and ship as explicit nulls; `lair` carries a short habitat note, because where a wandering animal dens is an encounter fact rather than a loot one.
  • Added after a post-hoc comparison against independent GURPS fan conversions of this creature: Peripheral Vision. The comparison surfaced the gap; the build is still ours.
